title: Decent Owner-Authorized Storage Grant Semantic Envelope v1
description: Provider-neutral semantic representation. The Keycloak 26.8.0 adapter embeds this object as the RFC 7523 assertion's decent_grant claim; this schema alone does not define an OAuth assertion or issuer profile.

owner_identifier.description: Exact raw UTF-8 identifier; no normalization or alias expansion.

storage_aud.description: Operator-configured Storage resource identifier, compared exactly.

purpose.description: Opaque exact value; v1 defines no global purpose vocabulary.

consent_exp.description: Unix epoch seconds, within IEEE-754 safe-integer range.

ed25519PublicKey.description: 32-byte Ed25519 public key in lowercase hex.

storageDigest.description: Existing Storage Object's exact-content SHA-256 digest.

extensions.description: Optional namespaced primitive metadata only. V1 consumers ignore all extension values; they MUST NOT carry or widen authorization.
